bbox_note: bbox_pct values are approximate (estimated by eye) and are only meant for matching regions; x, y = top-left, w, h = size, in percent of the page.
excluded: Printed page number '4' (bottom left of the last panel).
page_notes: Romance story. Balloon lettering is upper case; the narration caption is in mixed-case script and is kept in its own case. Several letters in the middle tier are damaged in printing (broken strokes in R, E, H); they are still readable and are transcribed as the intended letters, with a note.

regions.notes: Running header with the comic's title, above the panels.

regions.text: THERE ARE MANY THINGS ABOUT MESSALIA YOU DO NOT KNOW! THEY WILL NEVER LET ME LEAVE THIS COUNTRY... NOT WHILE I CAN BE OF USE TO THEM!
BUT THAT'S RIDICULOUS! YOU'RE REALLY HALF AMERICAN ANYWAY!
NO, GAIL! YOU DO NOT KNOW THE LENGTHS TO WHICH THEY WILL GO! I WOULD BE AFRAID FOR YOU AS WELL AS FOR MYSELF!
regions.notes: Drawn 'NO,GAIL!' with no space. 'LENGTHS' is badly printed (the E is broken and the S smudged) but the word is clear from context and the visible strokes.

regions.text: POOR WILL! IT SEEMS INCREDIBLE THAT THEY COULD HAVE HALF BROKEN THE SPIRIT OF A MAN LIKE YOU! BUT I'M NOT AFRAID OF THEM!
regions.notes: Lettered 'INCRED-' / 'IBLE' across a line break; written as the whole word.

regions.text: Again Will tried to plead with me but I stopped him...
regions.notes: Mixed-case script lettering on the page background (no box), with a decorative capital 'A'.

regions.text: AH, MISS MANNERS, OUR CHIEF ENGINEER SEEMS TO HAVE SOFTENED YOUR ICY HEART, A FEAT I DID NOT SEEM ABLE TO ACCOMPLISH!
regions.notes: Print damage: the R of OUR, the H of HAVE and the E/A of HEART are broken; intended letters transcribed. Drawn 'MANNERS,OUR' with no space.
'VIRLO' read from a slightly broken R; the speaker addresses the officer, whose name appears only here.

regions.text: OF COURSE I UNDERSTAND, MY DEAR NEKARO! ONE NEED NOT EXPLAIN WHY ONE HAS KISSED A PRETTY AMERICAN GIRL! I ASSURE YOU THAT WHEN SHE DECIDES TO KISS ME, I WILL NOT EXPLAIN TO YOU EITHER!
regions.notes: Drawn 'IUNDERSTAND' with no space. Several E's and the R of DEAR are broken in print (COURSE, DEAR, NEED, ONE, EXPLAIN); intended letters transcribed.

regions.text: YOU CANNOT TALK THAT WAY ABOUT HER!

AH! SO SHE HAS ALREADY INFECTED YOU WITH THE SO-CALLED CHIVALRY OF THE DEMOCRACIES! FOOL! THESE AMERICAN WOMEN ARE FREE WITH THEIR KISSES, ESPECIALLY WHEN THEY WANT TO MAKE A MAN TALK, PERHAPS MAKE HIM SLANDER HIS OWN LAND!

regions.notes: Jagged burst balloon; large bold letters, 'LIE!' italic.
Red outlined display letters on a yellow panel, set at an angle.
